---
title: "Good habits, bad habits"
author: "Mohammad Tanviruzzaman"
date: "2026-10-09"
categories: [life]
---

> A habit is a cue-response loop built through repetition and immediate reward. Lowering friction reduces the activation energy to act, locking the loop in place. Using far less cognitive energy than deliberate choice, it runs automatically—persisting without reward, and remaining unseen until tracking restores control.
